Attanagalu(lla)(vihāra)vaṃsa
Bud. Pāli. History of prince Saṅghabodhi an. the temple of Attanagalla, written in the 12th cent., by a pupil of Anomadassī.
Alwis p.. 11-39. Cambr. Uni. Pāli. p. 145. Colombo p.. 50. 53. Colombo D. I. 1815. Malalasekhara, Pāli. Lit. of Ceylon p.. 253. 284.

Attaragamabhaṇḍārarājaguru
Bud. Pāli writer; pupil of Saraṇaṅkara.
--Kārakapupphamañjarī, on cases in Pāli gr. Colombo D. I. 2093.
--Saddamālā, a Pāli gr. based on Kaccāyana.
--Sudhīramukhamaṇḍana, on Pāli compounds. Colombo D. I. 2160. [Page101-a.
Law, His.. Pāli Lit. p. 636; Malalasekhara, Pāli. Lit. of Ceylon p. 283.
